create_episode: create an Episode with episode_id, scene_id, start_position, and start_rotation quaternion
build_dataset_from_json: build a Dataset from a JSON string with episode information and scenes directory
filter_episodes: filter a Dataset episodes using a callable predicate function and return a new Dataset
split_dataset: split a Dataset into N subsets with optional scene collation and uneven split support
iterate_episodes: iterate over episodes with cycling, shuffle, scene grouping, and max scene repeat controls
